verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a per-chat tool approval mode. In the default 'auto' mode the AI can explore, but nothing changes on disk and no command runs until the user approves, with Allow/Deny tool cards for pending actions. That is a first-party permission mode limiting what the agent can touch, though the docs also note plugins execute arbitrary Python on the server. missing for 10: documented container/VM sandboxing of tool execution, finer-grained tool policies (per-tool allow/deny lists), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, risky tool runs are containable — container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what the agent can touch

citations.quote: Every chat has a tool approval mode, set from the + menu in the chat input
